fusions.name: Closing Pass
fusions.desc: A lunging bite on a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 22 damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach, and makes it [Bleeding] for 3 damage a second for 4 seconds. Usable only on an enemy at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Circling Cut
fusions.desc: A turning slash that deals 4 damage to every enemy within 2 tiles. Your movement speed rises 10% for 2 seconds after.

fusions.name: Turn Behind
fusions.desc: Steps you instantly to a spot up to 5 tiles away. Your dodge chance rises by 5%.

fusions.name: Scent in the Water
fusions.desc: Against an enemy at low health, your damage rises by 12%.
